title: The Shattered Semitone (v2) — Concerto Grosso for Dual Guitars & 53-EDO Orchestra
description: Stage-independent ~10-minute 53-EDO concerto grosso starring Classical Nylon Guitar and Acoustic Steel Guitar alongside Orchestral Harp, Indian Shruti Lutes (Sitar, Dotara, Ektara), Chamber Orchestra, and Cathedral Pipe Organ. Engineered with zero Western pitch-bend glides and crisp plucked transients to prove 53-EDO vs 12-TET immediately: sparkling cross-string campanella cascades inside single 12-TET semitones, Eagle-53 3-step (25:24) chromatic mediants, East-West 1-2 shruti raga dialogues, a 5-variation C -> Am -> Dm -> G -> C syntonic comma passacaglia pump (k = -2 -> +3), exposed guitar [38, 2, 16] Ab++ Major chords that shear into root-position A minor in 12-TET, 7-limit & 11-limit glass harmonics, and a triumphant 19-track finale.
